form.codexLoginHelp: Creating the account runs official codex login and opens the browser. Complete authorization yourself; if the browser did not open, use Open login terminal on the account row.

accounts.awaitBrowser: Waiting for browser authorization. If it did not open, choose Open login terminal.
accounts.reviewLogin: Confirm the identity from this login
accounts.quotaIdentityChanged: The login identity changed. Accounts were reloaded; check quota again.

structure.helpDir: Arrange child containers horizontally or vertically
structure.helpHideEmpty: Hide the container when all its items are hidden or moved; stays visible while editing layout.
structure.helpName: Display label only; changing it does not affect layout.
structure.helpOpenPolicy: Default target container for triggers inside this container. When forced, individual trigger settings are ignored.
structure.helpOpensHere: Triggers whose views open in this container. You can rebind any trigger individually.
structure.helpSpan: Share of width / height in the parent container; Fit sizes to content.
structure.helpTriggersHere: Where each trigger inside this container opens: follow the container policy or pick a specific container.
structure.name: Name

surface.help: Relative 0% inherits the parent opacity; higher values layer on top. Absolute ignores parent opacity. Affects only the surface, not text or controls.
surface.label: Surface

structure.whyBuiltinProps: Built-in container direction and share are determined by its content
structure.whyForced: Target is enforced by its container
structure.whyLocked: Locked: holds settings entries or space structure
structure.whyNoKids: This container holds built-in content and cannot contain child containers

group.accentHelp: Primary buttons, links, mentions, and focus rings. Hover, soft surface, and link text are derived from it.
group.memberColorsHelp: All members share lightness and chroma; each member picks its own hue in member settings. Names and message stripes use the name set; avatar backgrounds use the tint set.
group.messageAndCodeHelp: Member messages use a left stripe with no fill; your messages use a bubble with its own hue.
group.statusHelp: Used only for status signals. All four share chroma; OK, warning, and info share lightness while danger keeps a deeper lightness.
group.surfacesHelp: Absolute surface steps: rail → sidebar → page → group. Hover, selected, and input layers overlay ink on whichever surface they sit on.
group.typographyAndLinesHelp: Four text lightness steps plus two line overlays. Low chroma follows the neutral surface hue.

ext.installDirHelp: Select a built plugin package directory on the Hub machine; enable it after installation.
